title: 第23章 异象996第24章 春风一度
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
“霜儿，你带茜茜去玩会儿。”商玄镜并没有直接回答，反而先将女儿递给了霜儿。
“我要跟漂亮哥哥一起玩。”茜茜两个小短腿拼命挣扎着。
“茜茜乖，他受伤了，需要好好休息，等他好了你再找他玩。”商玄镜耐心地摸了摸女儿的头发。
听到她这样说，茜茜懂事地点了点头：“好，茜茜不打扰漂亮哥哥休息了。”
离去时还不停地冲宋牧驰招手，看到这一幕，商玄镜微微一笑：“茜茜似乎很喜欢你。”
“茜茜确实很可爱。”宋牧驰心中也浮起一丝柔软，可惜宋老登没给他生个妹妹，不然从小就能玩了。
这个念头一出，他都愣住了，自己似乎已经彻底代入了这个时代了。
待女儿走远过后，商玄镜这才对绝命毒圣行了一礼：“毒圣前辈，妾身此行前来确实有一件事向您求证，不知道‘赤练断魂’是不是前辈之物？”
绝命毒圣点了点头：“不错，那确实是老夫早年研制的成名剧毒。”
听到他这话，商玄镜眼神中闪过一道寒光。
宋牧驰心中一动，莫名地觉得空气中弥漫着一股紧张的气息。
他好不容易保住一条命，可不想被殃及池鱼。
于是主动打破了宁静：“夫人为何会问这‘赤练断魂’？”
商玄镜犹豫了一下，望了一眼远处的茜茜，幽幽说道：“我生命中最重要之人就是因为‘赤练断魂’而死。”
宋牧驰脸色一变，这下麻烦了，看来要跟绝命毒圣不死不休了。
“原来如此，”绝命毒圣叹了一口气，“我这一生确实害了不少人，如今被寻仇也是罪有应得，夫人动手吧。”
商玄镜脸色变幻，似乎在思考对方这话是真是假。
绝命毒圣修为虽然没有她高，但绝命毒圣自保什么时候需要修为了？
看到双方剑拔弩张，宋牧驰额头渗出一滴汗珠，灵机一动：“夫人，我看毒圣前辈慈悲心肠，其中说不定有什么误会，不如问清楚为好。”
商玄镜犹豫了一下，想到如今自己有伤在身，茜茜也在这里，动起手来她也没有十足的把握，于是便顺势问道：“不知道阁下与燕北一剑有什么仇怨，为何要下‘赤练断魂’害他。”

宋牧驰心中一动，她刚刚所说的生命中最重要的人便是这个燕北一剑么，难道是她的情郎？
绝命毒圣面露疑惑之色：“燕北一剑死了么，我倒是没有听说。”
燕北一剑是燕国出名的强者，没想到已经死了。
“你下的毒，还不知道他死了么。”商玄镜眼神冷冽。
“他什么时候中毒死的？”绝命毒圣忽然问道。
商玄镜望着远处茜茜的身影，神情有些恍惚：“六年前的冬天……”
她永远不会忘了那一天，燕北一剑死了，亲妹妹也跟着殉情。
绝命毒圣摇头道：“我在这百花谷中隐居已经有十年，期间从来没有出去过，又岂会伤到你朋友。而且五十年前我创造出‘赤练断魂’，却不小心害死了我的心上人，从此视之不详，将之封存，再也没有用过此毒。”
商玄镜脸色巨变：“不是你？”
绝命毒圣微微摇头：“跟我来。”
旋即带着他们往房中走去。
商玄镜犹豫了一番，却不敢跟上去，毕竟绝命毒圣威名在外，鬼知道里面会不会有什么陷阱等着她，她不想再陷入之前那样被动的境地。
宋牧驰一咬牙，富贵险中求！
再说了，他感觉绝命毒圣不像在说假话。
于是主动跟了上去，帮商玄镜趟雷。
content_en:
"Shuang'er, take Sissy to play for a while." Shang Xuanjing did not answer directly. Instead, he handed his daughter to Shuang'er first.
"I want to play with my beautiful brother." Sissi struggled desperately with her short legs.
"Be good, Xixi. He is injured and needs a good rest. You can play with him when he is well." Shang Xuanjing patiently touched his daughter's hair.
Hearing what she said, Sissi nodded sensibly: "Okay, Sissi won't disturb the beautiful brother's rest."
When he left, he kept waving to Song Muchi. Seeing this scene, Shang Xuanjing smiled slightly: "Qianqian seems to like you very much."
"Sissi is indeed cute." Song Muchi also felt a softness in his heart. It was a pity that Song Laoden didn't give him a younger sister, otherwise he would have been able to play with her since he was a child.
As soon as this thought came out, he was stunned. He seemed to have completely entered this era.
After his daughter had gone far away, Shang Xuanjing bowed to the Poison Saint: "Senior Poison Saint, I have come to ask you for confirmation on something. I wonder if the 'Red Lian Duanhun' is a gift from my predecessor?"
The Deadly Poison Saint nodded: "Yes, that is indeed the famous poison I developed in my early years."
Hearing his words, a cold light flashed in Shang Xuanjing's eyes.
Song Muchi's heart moved, and he inexplicably felt a nervous atmosphere filling the air.
He managed to save his life, but he didn't want to harm Chi Yu.
So he took the initiative to break the tranquility: "Why would Madam ask about this 'Red Practice Broken Soul'?"
Shang Xuanjing hesitated for a moment, glanced at Qianqian in the distance, and said quietly: "The most important person in my life died because of the 'Red Practice Soul-Severing'."
Song Muchi's expression changed, he was in trouble now, he seemed to be fighting to the death with the Poison Saint.
"I see," the Poisonous Saint sighed, "I have indeed harmed many people in my life, and now I deserve my revenge. Madam, please take action."
Shang Xuanjing's expression changed, as if he was thinking about whether the other party's words were true or false.
Although the Deadly Poison Saint's cultivation is not as high as hers, when does the Deadly Poison Saint need to cultivate to protect himself?
Seeing the tense situation between the two sides, a drop of sweat broke out on Song Muchi's forehead, and he had an idea: "Madam, I see that Senior Poison Saint has a compassionate heart. There may be some misunderstanding, so it would be better to ask clearly."
Shang Xuanjing hesitated for a moment, thinking that now that she was injured and Qianqian was here, she was not completely sure about taking action, so she took advantage of the situation and asked: "I don't know what grudge your Excellency has against Yan Bei Yijian, why did you kill him with the 'Red Lian Duanhun'."
Song Muchi's heart moved. Was the most important person in her life that she just said was this Yan Bei Yijian? Could it be her lover?
The Deadly Poison Saint showed doubts on his face: "Did Yan Bei Yijian die? I haven't heard about it."
Yan Bei Yijian was a famous strong man in Yan country, but he didn't expect to be dead.
"You poisoned him, and you didn't know he was dead yet." Shang Xuanjing's eyes were cold.
"When did he die of poisoning?" The Poisonous Saint suddenly asked.
Shang Xuanjing looked at Sissi's figure in the distance with a dazed expression: "In the winter six years ago..."
She will never forget that day, Yan Bei died with a sword, and his sister also died in love.
The Deadly Poison Saint shook his head and said: "I have lived in seclusion in Baihua Valley for ten years, and I have never gone out during this period. How could I hurt your friend? And fifty years ago, I created the 'Red Practice Soul-Severing', but accidentally killed my sweetheart. From then on, I regarded it as unknown, sealed it, and never used this poison again."
Shang Xuanjing's face changed drastically: "Not you?"
The Deadly Poison Saint shook his head slightly: "Follow me."
Immediately led them to the room.
Shang Xuanjing hesitated for a while, but didn't dare to follow. After all, the Deathly Poison Saint was famous, and who knew there might be any traps waiting for her inside. She didn't want to fall into the passive situation like before.
Song Muchi gritted his teeth and sought wealth in danger!
Besides, he felt absolutelyIt doesn't look like Mingdu Sheng is telling lies.
So he took the initiative to follow him and help Shang Xuanjing get through the thunder.
